'''Arturo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[King/Legends|King]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orocco]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], his daughter [[Mi]] was kidnapped by a small band of criminals led by [[Grintlok]], who demanded ransom in exchange for her release. Unfortunately, at the same time [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] seized control of Orocco, and all Arturo's wealth was gone overnight. Having no way to repay the debt, he turned to a criminal mastermind [[Raze (criminal)|Raze]], who considered Arturo to be his friend, or at least pretended to. Raze sent a bounty hunter [[Dust (bounty hunter)|Dust]], who tracked the kidnappers to the planet of [[Cataalda]]. Raze and Arturo arrived at the planet only to find that a third party&mdash;a smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]&mdash;had already rescued the princess and was glad to return her to her father. Arturo generously offered Solo Mi's hand in marriage, but Han already had [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|another princess]] on his hands, so he chose to refuse the offer.
